title: Chapter 503
paragraphs: Chapter 503
Episode 139. Threat (2)
Runkandel and Sandra were watching the battle unfolding in the sky.
A little farther down, explosions continued to occur on the ground as well.
The battle was still ongoing between Kinzelo and the Gifl in the underground construction site.
The situation wasn't great.
Yona was still unconscious, carried by Jin, and Joshua, Difus, and Jane had also sustained significant injuries from the battle they had just fought.

There was no immediate way to confirm the life or death of the Black Knight Mon who had stayed in the construction site. Among the group, only Jin and Murakan could engage in combat under relatively normal conditions.
Moreover, it would take a lot of time to leave the Ruterio Magic Federation.
"Kyahahat, Jin. It seems that Hedo managed to deceive them well. Judging by my aunt's direct magicians going in the wrong direction."
Sandra said in an excited voice, but the Ghost Riders were not fools.
If they couldn't find any traces of escape in the Kuta Forest, they would definitely change direction and greatly expand their search area.
'The state of emergency must have been declared long ago, so even excluding the Ghost Riders, the entire area adjacent to the Sota Desert would be under lockdown and on high alert.'
They had to break through all of that to return to the family.
'The good thing is that Kinzelo is likely to help us escape.'
Kinzelo.
Another enemy that appeared just in time.
Jin was convinced that the appearance of the ship Gruenil was not a coincidence.

'They might not have been fully aware of what was happening at the two magical towers just now, but at least they know that we, or rather Yona, have stolen the vault. Yona was the one who received their request.'
Just before passing out, Yona handed Jin 'two' items.
One was the ship's blueprint, and the other was a small machine of an unfamiliar type.
The machine was slightly smaller than a palm-sized board, and when shaken, it made a sound like complex gears were entwined inside.
Its purpose was unknown.
Neither Joshua, who had heard about the existence of the machine along with the blueprint from the prophet in advance, nor Sandra Gifl knew the exact use of the machine.
However, it was certain that it was a very important item since it was with the blueprint.
The energy emanating from the item itself was also strangely extraordinary.
'Kinzelo sent Gruenil to prevent us from being defeated by Drakka's reinforcements.'
The reason was none other than this:
Kinzelo was also initially causing all this trouble to rob the vault. Naturally, they needed to take the items Runkandel had obtained.
If Runkandel was captured by the Gifl's main force, they would never be able to get those items again.
Who Kinzelo, who was in charge of finding the group, was and when they would arrive was important.
Whether they could handle it with their current power, or if they could have a conversation. It would be nice if someone meeting at least one of those conditions came.
However, even if someone who did not meet the conditions came, it would not be a big problem.
'As long as I have the blueprint and the machine, I have the initiative no matter what situation arises with Kinzelo coming to find us.'
While Jin was organizing his thoughts, Sandra kept talking without a break.
"Ah, if it weren't for my little sister, I would have been the one carried on your back. It's a shame, but I can't make someone who's unconscious like this walk... Shall I at least link arms?"
The other Runkandels watching Sandra were barely hiding their troubled feelings in various ways.

'Why is Sandra Gifl trying to help the youngest? Judging by the atmosphere on Sandra's side, they seem like a newlywed couple who can't live without each other. Thanks to that, we got out of the two magical towers easily, but I wonder if this is right.'

'Even if Sandra Gifl hadn't stepped forward, the youngest and Murakan would probably have been able to escape the two magical towers. I don't accept it, but Hedo absolutely follows Sandra Gifl's orders, and definitely tried to kill me, Difus, and Jane until Sandra ordered to open the way.'
If it weren't for Sandra, the rest of the Runkandels, excluding Jin and Murakan, would have definitely perished.
Difus and Joshua were sure of that.
It would have actually happened that way. Even considering Yona's performance, Hedo was not someone the riders could handle.
Jin also found it difficult to figure out how to deal with her.
"Sandra Gifl."
"Yes, Jin."
"I'm not your lover, let alone your husband."
Jin couldn't understand Sandra's feelings at all.
Even if they set aside their origins as Runkandel and Gifl, which could never be together, her one-sided affection was beyond the realm of being described as peculiar.
The two had first met on the Gaipa Highway, and that was as enemies.
Sandra's behavior wasn't scary or seriously uncomfortable.
However, Jin couldn't feel comfortable in a situation where he was only receiving help from her without any compensation.

"Nevertheless, it is true that your help saved the lives of my brothers and the Black Knight, so I want to repay you in some way. If you need something, ask for it. If it's something I can do, I'll carry it out after we escape."
Upon hearing Jin's calm voice, Sandra closed her mouth for the first time.

No matter how strange her actions were, and even though she was an enemy, it wasn't an easy task to treat someone who was unconditionally trying to help so coldly. Even as he spoke, Jin felt a sharp sting in his conscience, or something similar.
However, he had to draw a line. He thought that was his position, and the whole world would think the same.
Sandra seemed quite shocked by Jin's calm voice.
"Oh... kid, that's a very cold line. Cool, very cool."
Murakan, feeling uncomfortable with the quietened Sandra, blurted out such words. He, too, had never met anyone like Sandra in his more than three thousand years of life.
However, the reason Sandra was silent was not because she was hurt by Jin's dry attitude.
"That's right, Lord Murakan. You know it well, he's too cool, our Jin..."
She simply closed her mouth because she thought Jin's cool-headed appearance was shockingly cool.
'How could she react like this to what I said?'
It was a shocking moment for everyone, including Jin, and they all felt chills running down their spines.
"The more I see, the more attractive you are! I'm more certain now, the best thing I've done in my life is to love Jin!"
"No, what does that mean?"
"I will definitely marry Jin. That's right, we're not lovers or a married couple yet. It seems like I was a little ahead of myself."
"That... just a little?"
Jin almost stammered.
"Jin, there's no reason for me to have decided to love you. So I don't expect any compensation, and like many other loves, there's no need to understand it."
Sandra smiled and added these words.
"It's just a spark in a boring life. Sometimes, lightning strikes from a clear sky, doesn't it?"
Watching Sandra suddenly praising love, Jin concluded that there was no need to worry about her any longer.
There was no answer.
"I get what you're saying."
"Of course, this love without compensation only applies to Jin and my little sister. Since I saved the other three of you... what should I receive in return? Hmmm."
"Why does it only apply to Yona?"
Difus asked.
"Because she's my little sister?"
"Oh, I see."
He also decided not to think too deeply about it.
It seemed that it would actually be easier for them to understand a character like Sandra Zifel.
"First of all, Jin has a special affection for his siblings, right? As far as I know, the only siblings Jin has a good relationship with are his older sister and younger sister."
"Mary would probably be included too."
"I'll remember that. And you, the fourth generation?"
"I'm not sure, but I'm almost certain that the person our youngest sibling hates the most in the world is that person."
"So, I was a bit puzzled too. If I were Jin, I would have killed the second generation using Hedo earlier."
"It's a situation where we can't afford to lose even a single hand for escape. It can't be helped. But if it were me, I would have done the same. Our youngest has a big appetite."
"There's not a single thing about him that's not cool from head to toe."
Giggling, Difus and Sandra seemed to get along quite well.
"Difus, get a grip. Even though she's showing us kindness, she's still our enemy. And she's a pureblood Zifel, too. Are we in a relationship to exchange such nonsense jokes?"
At that, Difus's eyes darkened as if he had been waiting for such a reaction.
"Is it a joke? This bastard."
"What did you say?"

"I'm at the point where I want to tear you apart and kill you right now. You should know best what you've done wrong. You, the second generation of our family, who became the next family head thanks to your mother! You've put everyone in danger during this mission. It's no different than betrayal."

"Betrayal? That seems more fitting for you, who's now chattering with a Zifel. Is this because you didn't share all the information? I know you don't like me, but I just thought that it would be more suitable for the mission's success. Hedo was an unforeseen variable."
"You're shamelessly babbling. You can't deny the fact that if it weren't for our youngest sibling, your brilliant decision would have led us to annihilation, can you?"
"You're whining like a child, Difus."
"...Fourth generation, it's better to stop. It's urgent to get out of enemy territory."
When Jane intervened, Difus spat out a sarcastic laugh.

"For the mission, for the family... it's disgusting. How many benefits have you gained over time under such flimsy pretexts? Whether your words are true or false, there will surely come a moment when everyone can find out."
Silence began again (except for Sandra).
The wind erased the footsteps of the group.
And when the sound of battle and explosions from the sky and the dry dock had moved much farther away, and the thickened sandstorm blurred their vision.
The group could confirm the fact that a dark silhouette of a person was approaching them from afar.
'What was expected has come.'
It was Kinzelo's man.
